CorrectionAction.description:
The three writer mutations the entity surface supports. `Tag` and `Reassign`
both bind a surface to a named canonical entity (tagging a previously
unrecognized mention vs. moving a mis-grouped one); they carry the same data
and are applied identically, so they share [`CorrectionAction::Assign`].

oneOf.description: Bind the surface to the entity with this canonical name (tag or reassign).
Suppress the surface: it is not a real entity mention.

EntityCorrection.description:
A writer's authoritative decision about one mention surface, persisted and
reapplied over the automatic resolution. A correction is keyed by the
`surface` form it targets; the caller looks corrections up per document.

action.description: What the writer decided for that surface.

surface.description: The mention surface this decision applies to (e.g. "Mr. Condrey").

lexicon.description: Replacement list of whole-word editorial terms; empty by default.

modelRevision.description: Caller changes this when replacing an injected model/backend.

rules.description: None selects all supported rules; Some(empty) selects none.

evidence.description:
Primary passage first; contradictory passages carry the Conflict role.
Aggregate findings may have no pinpoint evidence; their scope is explicit.

ModelManifest.description:
V1 profiles encode with tokenizer special tokens, reject tokenizer-side
truncation/padding, and right-pad IDs with `padding_token_id` and masks/types
with zero. Embeddings use masked mean pooling without normalization; class
logits are softmaxed and remapped to the crate's canonical label order.

labels.description: Exact supported label names in source-logit order; empty for embeddings.

sceneIds.description: Presentation order, never changed by chronology.

evidence.description:
Primary passage first; contradictory passages carry the Conflict role.
Aggregate findings may have no pinpoint evidence; their scope is explicit.
